svg.title: CareCart system architecture
svg.desc: Source-mapped architecture of the current CareCart application: clinic browser, Vercel Next.js frontend, Supabase authentication, EC2 Caddy and Fastify tenant API, separate registry and clinic SQLite databases, inventory and policy workers, optional NEAR AI Cloud, protected committer and requester processes, independent observer, NEAR testnet safety vault, CCUSD token and controlled supplier account. Wallet funding and contract callbacks are separate from stock receiving. Dashed blue paths are optional inference or read-only verification. Mainnet and live supplier integrations are roadmap items.

g.text: Clinic operations, purchasing authority and independently verified settlement.
AWS EC2 · separate processes / shared local storage

a.title: Next.js application — open implementation
a.text: app.carecart.xyz · clinic UI + server-side API proxy
HTTP-only session cookies · no payment role keys

a.title: Tenant API — open implementation
a.text: Fastify · verified membership + clinic runtime routing
Inventory, orders, funding, policy, activity + team APIs

a.title: SQLite persistence — open implementation
a.text: Per-clinic files: stock, orders + payment journal

a.title: Inventory worker — open implementation
a.text: Uses the clinic engine + persisted records

a.title: Automatic-policy authorizer — open implementation
a.text: Checks item, supplier, amount, expiry + policy version
Key-free; exceptions remain held for review

a.title: NEAR safety vault — open implementation
a.text: Automatic / hard / daily limits · reservations + pause
Callbacks + treasury recovery; no stock mutation

g.text: Role keys stay out of the app and API.
Admin, guardian and upgrade authority remain separate.
Diagram maps code, not deployment health.
Mainnet and live suppliers are not activated.
systemd · health checks · SQLite backups · browser acceptance · NEAR Sandbox · source / code-hash verification
Source-mapped schematic · See ARCHITECTURE.md for component references, authorization and recovery details.
